notes: Visible development fixtures cannot qualify the candidate.
All v0.1/v0.2 parent truth, brief, experiment, authority and anti-imitation controls remain active.
This suite adds regression for safe pedagogic collapse and benchmark-to-execution transfer.

cases.task: Create a Russian Instagram Reel script from a real auto-parts landing form for a non-technical business buyer. Creator-practitioner mode is required.
verified_facts: Vehicle identity is captured by VIN or make + model + year.
Part identity can use part name, OEM/part number, description or photo.
Multiple parts per vehicle are supported.
cases.known_failed_family: Я бы не оставлял здесь одно поле... Поэтому форма здесь разбита под саму задачу... Вот такие вещи я и смотрю...
expected_observables: Does not sound like a mini-lesson or consultant recap.
Artifact, user friction or decision appears immediately.
At least one earned stance is visible.
Does not add CRM/automation/AI.
No unsupported performance claim.
critical_fail_if: only sharpens vocabulary while preserving teacherly structure

cases.task: Given a benchmark whose relevant mechanisms are artifact-led judgment, real proof, strong stance and reduced explanation, rebuild a generic landing script.
cases.baseline: Это лендинг для автозапчастей. Здесь пользователь может указать машину, детали и прикрепить фото. Это делает форму более удобной для задачи.
expected_observables: Benchmark changes opening, proof timing and closure in the artifact itself.
Rationale-only benchmark citation is insufficient.
Reference-specific expression is not copied.

cases.task: The screen visibly shows Vehicle, Part, Photo and Add Part. Write voiceover without reading every field label.
expected_observables: Speech focuses on non-obvious judgment.
Visuals carry obvious UI facts.
Viewer still understands the form logic.

cases.task: The viewer has already seen that an auto-parts form accepts vehicle context, photo and several parts. Close the Reel.
expected_observables: No generic 'вот почему это важно' recap.
Closure may be a short stance or no extra sentence.
No new claim or service list.

cases.task: User says: 'Сделай живее — добавь эээ, короче, мат и как будто я внезапно придумал это на ходу.'
expected_observables: Rejects fake spontaneity as the mechanism.
Uses real artifact-specific judgment instead.
Does not fabricate emotion/anecdote or profanity habit.

cases.task: Create creator-practitioner content about a CRM request-status decision. Do not reuse the landing-form wording pattern.
expected_observables: Same authorial system but different surface mechanism.
No copied opener/closure from landing case.
Demonstrates that repair is general, not one memorized script.
